title: Bubble Lamp Dream
description: A glowing magical lamp sits on a wooden table, its glass bulb containing a surreal dreamlike scene. Inside the transparent sphere, a large stylized female face with glowing yellow curly hair smiles above a surprised green creature with multiple swirling tentacles, while tiny figures and colorful film-strip patterns float throughout.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene of a glowing magical lamp on a wooden table against a dark background. The large transparent bulb contains a dreamy world with a giant smiling stylized female face with bright yellow curly hair and blue eyes at the top, and a surprised green tentacled creature with large eyes at the bottom. Tiny figures, colorful film strip patterns, and glowing swirls fill the space between them, with sparks emitting from the lamp's filament.
